# test-data-factory

> Typed test data factories for Python dataclasses: values inferred from type hints, seeded and reproducible across Python versions, with sequences, lazy fields and ranges Python package `trysac-test-data-factory`, import name `test_data_factory`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
